improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value proposition and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter—critical channels for reaching business professionals and traders. Including the three free searches creates a low-friction call to action.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces the product name and its core function, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) and includes a clear, low-friction CTA mentioning the free trial—reducing hesitation for first-time visitors without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's full capabilities—including voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the conversion point where free users hit the paywall. By clearly explaining what happens next and immediately reinforcing the low entry price and key benefits, it reduces friction and uncertainty at the critical decision moment, helping convert trial users into paying members.
